Use case: stylized-concept. Generate exactly one standalone family mastery paw emblem for the Puff Trails locked design system, matching the Family Mastery board. A glossy rounded plush/enamel lavender-pink paw print: one large rounded heart-like central paw pad and four smaller round toe pads above it. Rich purple raised beveled edging, warm pink interiors and creamy highlights, cute premium toy-like 3D material, straight-on orthographic symmetrical icon. This is ONLY the paw symbol, NO shield, NO medal frame, NO ribbon, NO text, NO badge background, NO character. Centered, entire silhouette within canvas, substantial transparent padding. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow. Crisp clean alpha, fully opaque colored interior.

Refinement: Edit the paw emblem only to remove the entire purple glow/aura around it. Keep its five glossy pink paw pads and thick purple beveled edges precisely. Everything outside the actual solid paw outline must be fully transparent alpha 0, including between toes. No outer shadows, no bloom, no gradient cloud. Entire solid pink-and-purple toy emblem opaque alpha255 internally. Clean softly antialiased silhouette, transparent background. No other change.
provenance.origin: AI generated standalone paw emblem; no character redraw
provenance.postprocessing: Disconnected alpha specks removed; near-opaque interior normalized; centered 880px within1024.

limitations: Visual asset library only. Tier labels, progress quantities and milestone thresholds are illustrative; no gameplay rules or entitlement changes. Solo-first launch: personal prestige is cosmetic; Event Champion is future-only. Mastery badges do not alter family evolution, cannon upgrades or collision sizes. New ornaments are AI generated; approved portraits and economy art are reused. Runtime labels should remain localized text. PNG/WebP exports are not a tested game integration or animation rig.
